slipwai-graph.purpose: The slipwai factory itself: the CLI that generates and adopts product repositories, the assets it copies into them, and the delivery method (/drive, /cruise, the gate) those repositories run

why: Make the delivery loop faster without weakening its gates: tree-shaped merges, scoped and memoised gates, incremental event-model rendering, routing by difficulty and role (PRD: Faster Slipwai)

because: the trigger — 'Make the delivery loop faster without weakening its gates: tree-shaped merges, scoped and memoised gates, incremental event-model rendering, routing by difficulty and role (PRD: Faster Slipwai)' — names neither a platform, a delivery problem, a change problem, a capability nor a host, so no strategy follows from it; leave the architecture where it is until it does, and take the delivery rungs below, which pay off regardless
before: a pipeline that deploys on a passing `verify` — the path to production is `scripted`
a green suite in the gate — the safety net is `tests-exist`
